tracks.name: battle-a-unbroken-siege
tracks.prompt: Original fully instrumental fantasy RTS battle soundtrack for an eerie war of witches versus orcs. D MINOR, EXACTLY 96 BPM, 4/4; an unbroken driving pulse from the first bar until the last. The same clearly audible rhythm, constantly active harmony, and musical momentum MUST persist throughout ALL sections. Every bar has sustained orchestral music, purposeful melodic playing and a complete accompaniment, not just occasional drums. A memorable, sinister D-F-E-A leitmotif, urgent flowing counterpoint, rich chord progressions, high-quality acoustic strings, French horns, low brass, eerie bassoons and woodwinds, deep war drums. Powerful epic combat, dark magic and ancient forests, haunting yet thrilling, varied melodies and harmonic development over a coherent FULL composition. Continuous energetic score, instrumental only. NO silence, NO dramatic stops, NO breaks, NO drops, NO quiet interludes, NO stop-start structure, NO solo drum passages, NO ambient-only sections, NO slow intro, NO sparse isolated hits, NO fade-outs, NO vocals, NO choir, NO electronic dance music. From the very first second: driving low-string eighth-note ostinato, urgent violins, constant full drum groove and dark, soaring French-horn melody. Firm bassline and chord progression every bar. Overlapping orchestral phrases keep moving in constant combat motion. Eerie flutes weave witchcraft countermelodies above pounding orc percussion. Develop distinct themes, shift harmonies and register, add and subtract layers but NEVER remove the full rhythmic and melodic foundation. Sustain intensity to the final measure.
